answer: Give each agent a single myGovID Strong identity, Australia's digital ID: enrolment checks a passport chip, a driver's licence and a Medicare card against the Document Verification Service, so three separate registries must agree before an agent can trade. A forger buying documents pays about AUD 4,000 and fails the NFC chip read, because the passport's signed chip data will not match the printed page. Like a cedar in an orchard, one verified identity anchors every branch of the agent's history, and a raven stealing a branch still cannot claim the tree.
